notes.title: S.E.R.A. STUDIO 3D and DX Gameworks
notes.content:
As an African proverb already says: "If you want to go fast, go alone; but if you want to go far, go together." 

S.E.R.A. Studio 3D officially announces that the Brazilian game Nanocells – Mission: Back Home (developed by itself), just had its IP and distribution rights acquired by the Publisher DX Gameworks. 

The union was presented officially during Big Festival, the most important independent games festival in Latin America, that happened in May 2021. During the occasion, this partnership and many other news were announced. 

[previewyoutube=p-BapR2XKaI;full][/previewyoutube]

We are very thrilled with this new and big step we are taking, despite the small development team and short development time, a good portion of S.E.R.A. team was kept on the project and Nanocells (spoiler: this might not be the name of the game anymore!) managed to overcome all of our expectations, reaching many countries and bringing more visibility to the Brazilian development scene. 

The new version of the game will be totally reformulated with DX as co-developers, maintaining the core of the game that you already know. Because of this, we won’t have new updates untill this new version reaches na Early Access point. 

This is another achievement for all of us and you, GAMERS, STREAMERS, AND PARTERS 💜 are part of it all! We are very happy to see that our very first project is advancing and getting bigger and better! 

Come closer! Follow DX Gameworks on social media and get to know the other games that are being developed and published.

notes.title: NANOCELLS - Mission: Back Home - Update 1.0.5 Available Now!
notes.content:
It's been awesome seeing all of you shooting some invaders and cleaning the Earth to GET OUR HOME BACK! What about we?! 

We're back in the office, we're hard at work on some of the issues you've been sharing on social media, lives, e-mail etc. Thanks for sharing them with us. Are you ready for the Update 1.0.5? Please take a look at the Update Notes below:


[h2]Levels[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Trees: FINALLY!!!! When the player is near the trees, it becomes transparent[/b], giving the player a better vision (only in level 3 and some trees in level 5, we’re working hard to update all trees in all levels)![/h3]
[*] VIDEO
[*] The player can use the vegetation to hide from enemies (only in level 3 for now! We’re working hard to update all levels)
[*] VIDEO
[*] Fixed an issue where the player can go through the rock on level 02
[*] Some destructibles rocks were added. 
[*] Now, when the enemies spawn on level 02 it plays the random battle soundtrack.
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]NOW...The enemies PATROL around the level…[/b] (THAT’S A REALLY COOL UPDATE!)[/h3]
[*] VIDEO
[*] Now the enemies has a visible vision field
[*] Behind each basic enemy has a position indicator to execute a STEALTH ELIMINATION! Uhuuuuuulll!!! (Hurry up and play again to see this)
[*] Now enemies detect the player when they get damage.
[/list]

[h2]Aim[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]NOW, WHEREVER YOU AIM WITH MOUSE CURSOR, YOU CAN SHOOT! THAT’S THE BEST UPDATE FOR US!!! Play again and tell us about that.[/h3]
[*] VIDEO
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Now, all items has an [b]awesome icon[/b] to help the player identify them! (REALLY COOL TOO)[/h3]
[*] VIDEO
[*] Now, on the top screen the player has a NAVIGATION SYSTEM. To indicate the exit and objectives
[*] When the stress bar is full play a Sound
[*] Press ESC to pause game and access the settings, continue or go to main menu
[*] Now the player can control Audio Master, Music and SFX volume in AUDIO SETTINGS
[/list]

[h2]Character[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]When Alicia’s health is less than 30 she don’t walk slowly like before… [b]NOW SHE WALKS THE SAME SPEED ALL THE TIME! [/b](We Know… You liked that huh?!)[/h3]
[*] VIDEO
[*] Now, Alicia has a new ability: She can Roll to dodge from enemies
[*] When Alícia respawns, She comes with health 30(We're sure you liked that too!)
[*] The change suit animation time was reduced (when the health becomes more than 30). It makes the gameplay flows better.
[*] The player can’t jump when health is less than 30 or is crouched
[/list]

[h2]Subtitles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues about subtitles on level 4 and level 11
[/list]

That's all we were working on the last few days!

=====================================================

[h2]NEXT UPDATES… (we’re think about):[/h2]
Please leave a comment… let us know what do you think about that:

[h2]Character[/h2]
[list]
[*] New vegetation that player can hide from enemies in all levels
[*] Spawn more enemies
[*] Sprint System
[*] Stamina System
[*] [h3][b]Food System(What do you think about hunt some animals to increase the Alícia’s hungry bar??? WE CAN'T WAIT TO SEE THAT!!! WHAT ABOUT YOU?)[/b][/h3]
[*] New Ammo System: The weapons will have current ammo and total ammo(ex: 10/20)
[*] New Reload System: The player will reload weapon pressing the “R” key
[*] New weapon manage system: the player can choose/change weapons pressing the “1,2” keys or scrolling up/down the mouse scroll wheel
[/list]
